about: The public datasets a tutorial may use: its key (the dataset field of a tutorial's front matter), title, DOI and licence as read from the record, and the reference recipes of the suite (tools/door/plan.json, plan-macEM.json) that run on it. Only public datasets are listed. A new recipe for a public dataset is added here in the same change as its tutorial. tools/build_docs.py refuses a tutorial whose dataset is not here with a licence and a DOI, or whose recipe is not one of its dataset's.
